episodes.title: Highway
episodes.summary: After running a dangerous errand for her only friend, Kai finds herself in deep trouble. During a hasty escape, she comes across a mysterious group.

episodes.title: Heartbeat
episodes.summary: Seeking more intel, Kageyama reaches out to the all-seeing Digital Ministry's Justice Bureau. Meanwhile, Kai joins Suma Garage for her first delivery.

episodes.title: Grip
episodes.summary: The city transforms into a circuit for the Tokyo Warp Grand Prix. Hugo takes off on his own investigation while Kai teams up with Spoke for a delivery.

episodes.title: Mask
episodes.summary: After learning that the NARCS are targeting big events, Kai steals a bike and heads to the concert where Ayumi is, hoping to save her.

episodes.title: Compass
episodes.summary: Tensions run high in the hospital waiting room when Kageyama shows up with Yukio and asks for Suma Garage's cooperation in finding a traitor.

episodes.title: Tokyo
episodes.summary: United as a team, Spoke and Watari travel around the city to gather supporting data, while Hugo and Kai race against time to deliver the evidence.
